response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS win_difference FROM per_race AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY win_difference IS NULL, win_difference DESC LIMIT 10
